Frequently Asked Questions: Cloud Cost Optimization Explained

By Cloud Architecture Team | October 10, 2026

What is cloud cost optimization?

Cloud cost optimization is the practice of aligning cloud expenditure with actual resource consumption through continuous rightsizing, architecture tuning, and automated shutdown of idle dev environments.

How can teams reduce AWS egress charges?

You can reduce egress fees significantly by placing Cloudflare in front of origin servers, routing internal communication through private VPC endpoints, and compressing JSON payloads with Brotli.

What are reserved instances versus spot instances?

Reserved Instances
A long-term 1 or 3 year commitment offering discounts up to 72% for predictable, steady-state production workloads.
Spot Instances
Surplus compute capacity purchased at discounts up to 90% suitable for stateless, interruptible batch jobs.
